Filtering, Sorting & Pagination

Turning a validated query string into the where/orderBy/skip/take options a real ticket list needs.

  • Filtering with a Conditional where

    GET /tickets?status=open — building Prisma's where clause only when a filter was actually given.

  • Sorting with a Computed Key

    orderBy: { [sortBy]: order } — a property name decided at runtime, not written by hand.

  • Paginating the List

    skip/take turn a page number into a slice of rows; the controller turns the total row count into meta.
